notes.general_comments:
Almost all candidates completed the paper, so candidates appeared to have sufficient time. Examiners saw a
full range of performance, and almost all candidates were appropriately entered for the examination. Scripts
were legible and where candidates had crossed out work it was almost always clear what their intended
response was.
